paite: Aw, Israel suante aw, Aigupta gam a kipan a ka hon pikhiak inkote aw, TOUPA'N hichibang a nou ahon demna thu ngaikhia un,
heading: Israelte Thuhilhna
english: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

paite: "Noute kia leitung a inkuan tengteng a ka theih na hi ua; huaiziak in na thulimlouhna tengteng uah ka hon gawt ding," achi hi.
english: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

paite: Akithukim kei un mi nih apai-khawm ding ua hia?
heading: Zawlnei Nasep
english: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

paite: Humpinelkai in gammang a sa amat lai louh ngal in, ahumham ngei a hia? Humpinelkai lun lai in bangmah amat keileh akohawm sung a kipan ahumham ngei a hia?
english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

paite: Amah a dia tah a-om keileh, leitung a thang ah vasa a-awk thei a hia? Thang pen bangmah awk lou in lei a kipan in akisai dia hia?
english: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

paite: Khopi ah mi launa lou ah pengkul amut ding ua hia? TOUPA hih louh in khopi ah hoihlouhna ahong om dia hia?
english: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t done it?

paite: Diktak in Toupa PATHIAN in anasemmi, azawlneite kiang ah athuguk hilh lou in bangmah ahih kei ding hi.
english: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

paite: Humpinelkai ahumham a, kua ahia lau lou ding? Toupa PATHIAN in thu agen a, kua'n ahia gen lou thei ding?
english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

paite: Ashdod kumpipa' inn te leh Aigupta gam kumpipa' inn te ah gen unla, "Samaria tang tungte ah kikhawm unla, huai a buaina liantak omte leh huai lak a simmohna omte en un," chi in.
heading: Samaria Tunggikna
english: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

paite: "Akumpipa uh innte a hiamgamna leh kisuamna koihkhawm mite'n lah hihdik dan asiam ngal kei ua," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Gam kimvel in melma a-om lai ding a; na kiang a kipan na hatna alakhe ding a, na kumpipa' inn te ahihse ding uhi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Belampu in humpinelkai kam a kipan akhe nih hiam, bil them hiam, ahonkhia bang in, huchibang in Samaria a teng Israelte lupna ning leh lupna maimom puanphan lukham them toh hutkhiak in a-om ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

paite: Ngai unla, Jakob inkote tung ah theisak un,"
english: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.

paite: "Israel tatleknate amah tung ah ka gawtleh, huai ni chiang in, Bethel a maitamte leng ka gawt ngal dia; maitam kiite tankhiak in a-om ding ua, lei ah ake ding uh," sepaihte Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

paite: "Huan phalbi leh nipi inn ka satse ding a; saiha innte amangthang ding a, inn thupite'n tawpna anei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says Yahweh.
